sources.title: Viv0605101/anlp-a2-part2-optimizers · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The dense Part 1 architecture pre-trained for next-token prediction on browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus for one full pass (1x the dataset), once per optimizer. Every optimizer is implemented from scratch (only torch.optim.Optimizer is used, as a base class), one per category of Table 1 of Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them; Sophia-G is the bonus Hessian-based optimizer.

sources.title: abhirajratna/anlp-a2-optim-mars · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ANLP A2 Part 2: dense 33.6M decoder trained with MARS The dense model of Part 1 (variant v1: 8 layers, d_model 512, 8 heads, 2-layer MLP 2048), pretrained for next-token prediction on one pass over the training split of browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus, with a from-scratch MARS optimizer.
